tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find software products by task or name, with optional filters. Returns compact rows (id, entry price, cost-trap ids, pricing date). Ranking is text relevance only, never commission.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The full record for one product: plans, every cost trap with its full evidence sentence, pricing date, unknowns, price rules if any, and the vendor handoff with affiliate disclosure.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2 to 6 products side by side. Every requested id is returned, found or not. With units, adds the cheapest fitting plan's cost where price rules exist.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: The evidence behind a product's cost traps and free-plan flag: the exact sentences from our pricing notes, the date they were read and the source.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Cost of each plan at a team size (or companies/orders, per the product's axis) on monthly or annual billing: monthly equivalent, amount billed per period, commitment, minimums, add-ons and usage. tools.name: cost_at_growth
